user_saw: After rebuilding a source checkout, an operator could see the still-running Gateway fail to load modules from that checkout.
summary: The fix makes build entry points refuse to replace output shared by a running managed Gateway and lets stop and restart commands use the existing build.
reasoning: I verified that the July 1 snapshot already had tsdown recursively deleting output before rebuilding, and the later source-server updater described an existing practice of building before restarting the Gateway. The offline path history stopped at a missing parent, so I could not verify when the unsafe overlap first became possible or whether the same workflow had previously worked.
